02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE CODE

Curiosity first.
Ownership always.

I’m Olajide. You can call me Firewall.

I’m a Lagos-based Senior Software Engineer, Backend & Full-Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, AI Integration Specialist, and Founder with 6+ years of experience. I bring engineering depth, product ownership, and a practical approach to building software.

My work spans hospital software, diagnostic marketplaces, mobility systems, AI interviews, competitive challenges, and reading-to-action communities. These projects bring me close to the messy, interesting details that make a product useful.

I’m interested in working with founders and teams anywhere in the world: understanding the problem, making thoughtful technical choices, and building something worth putting in people’s hands.

THE JOURNEY / STILL BUILDING, STILL GROWING

Ambition without
borders.

Building from Nigeria has taught me that technical ability is one part of the journey. Finding the right opportunities, growing a business, and making my work visible take persistence too.

Opening global doors.

I’m pursuing remote opportunities across the US, Canada, and Europe, including Germany. Finding teams that hire from Nigeria or support relocation remains a challenge I’m actively working through.

From products to businesses.

With ACTA and ChallengeMe, shipping is only the beginning. I’m working through customer acquisition, retention, monetization, and turning useful software into consistent revenue.

Growing into leadership.

I’ve coordinated teams, managed priorities, and made architecture decisions. I’m building on that experience toward engineering management and technical project leadership.

Choosing where to focus.

Balancing engineering responsibilities, entrepreneurship, and multiple products means making deliberate choices about time, resources, and the work that deserves my attention.

Making experience count.

I’m seeking international roles and consulting partnerships that reflect the complexity of my work and create stronger, more predictable income.

Showing the work.

This portfolio is part of building a more visible professional brand: sharing what I build, telling the story clearly, and creating direct relationships with clients and teams.

happy path.

Chekker’s booking flow connects payment confirmation, retries, and settlements. The engineering lesson: financial rules belong in dependable transactions.
